metadata.database: A Deeper China | Jingdezhen decision layer

JZM01.guest_need: A visitor wants porcelain understood as a system of material, labour, kiln, design and trade.
JZM01.hidden_need: Turn a broad craft interest into one observable process question.
JZM01.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One system frame prevents a day of disconnected museums and studio photos.
JZM01.stop_condition: The guest can connect material, labour and market in one explanation.
JZM01.low_energy_branch: Use one museum/public process route and stop.
JZM01.rain_branch: Strong indoor branch after opening check.

JZM02.guest_need: A visitor wants imperial kiln history and technical standards, not just old objects.
JZM02.hidden_need: Choose one technical/history question and avoid heritage overload.
JZM02.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One kiln/technical lens explains production and management better than another gallery.
JZM02.stop_condition: One relationship between standard, technique and state/market is clear.
JZM02.rain_branch: Primary indoor branch after ticket/opening check.
JZM02.body_cost: Low physical load, high interpretation load.

JZM03.guest_need: A visitor wants public contemporary art/design rather than a private artist encounter.
JZM03.hidden_need: Match current programme and keep access public.
JZM03.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One current public ecosystem is more reliable than a list of private studios.
JZM03.stop_condition: One contemporary production question is answered.
JZM03.body_cost: Low-to-moderate walking with programme and transfer uncertainty.

JZM04.guest_need: A visitor needs to distinguish observing, collecting, buying and sourcing ceramics.
JZM04.hidden_need: Prevent authentication, valuation and shipping expectations.
JZM04.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A buying boundary protects the trip better than another market stop.
JZM04.stop_condition: The guest knows what is personal shopping and what cannot be verified.
JZM04.rain_branch: Covered market/showroom only after access check.

JZM05.guest_need: A visitor wants a workshop, residency or apprenticeship at the correct level.
JZM05.hidden_need: Separate a one-off tourist activity from professional learning.
JZM05.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: The level decision prevents a vague workshop promise from becoming a failed product.
JZM05.stop_condition: Purpose, skills, schedule, safety and release status are all clear.
JZM05.low_energy_branch: Use public observation instead of making.
JZM05.rain_branch: Only a confirmed indoor partner programme.
JZM05.body_cost: Variable physical/safety load with high schedule and language sensitivity.

JZM06.guest_need: A visitor needs kiln, dust, firing and work-safety reality before making.
JZM06.hidden_need: Keep the romance of craft subordinate to safety and delivery.
JZM06.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: One safety/delivery check prevents an unsafe or impossible workshop promise.
JZM06.stop_condition: The visitor accepts the real kiln, dust, firing and delivery limits.
JZM06.low_energy_branch: Do not add making; keep museum/process observation.

JZM07.guest_need: A visitor needs to decide how many days Jingdezhen and Dehua deserve.
JZM07.hidden_need: Protect making/artist time from a thin two-day checklist.
JZM07.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A pacing decision prevents a craft city from being reduced to a market stop.
JZM07.stop_condition: The visitor has minimum time and a distinct comparison question.
JZM07.low_energy_branch: Keep Jingdezhen and remove the extension.
JZM07.rain_branch: Use current rail and indoor programme before changing cities.

JZM08.guest_need: A visitor needs arrival, payment, language and delivery friction solved.
JZM08.hidden_need: Prevent a beautiful craft plan from failing operationally.
JZM08.why_this_over_nearby_alternative: A friction audit is more valuable than adding a fourth venue.
JZM08.stop_condition: The visitor can navigate, pay, communicate and receive/leave work safely.
JZM08.low_energy_branch: Keep one local public layer near the base.
JZM08.body_cost: Low sightseeing load, high operational sensitivity.
